describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): record the parser decision, ownership, reuse and lineage (#812)

rule: Each case names its input, the required and forbidden outcomes, the rules (VM..), files (MF..) and sections (MS..) it exercises, the existing evidence that pins part of it, and the node whose test makes it executable. Positive cases MP.. must validate and render; structural-failure cases MN.. must fail for exactly the named rule, never by keyword match. Synthetic cases are schema fixtures, not support claims: their cells stay at CT0-CT2.

cases.name: Current Vue 3.6 carrier and semantic profile
cases.input: Two manifests. Carrier: kind carrier, no release key, geometry dedicated-carrier, [parser] DK4 existing route PAR0 G03 with ParserId and ParserGrammarEpoch, [[embedding]] for script/template/style regions with map-chain kinds, [compiler] backend naming the Vue FrameworkProfileId with VDOM, Vapor and SSR compile capability. Semantic profile: kind semantic-profile, geometry not-applicable reason carrier-owned, release equal to the oracles.lock vue pin and to the ReleaseId inside its FrameworkProfileId, claims the Vue carrier, [[typeinfo_role]] for props/events/slots/expose, [custom_elements] producer and consumer rows, [[public_surface]] for every published surface, one cell per required profile-qualified CapabilityId seeded from G01/G05, per-surface maturity as a value.
cases.required: Both validate; rendering yields the T01, T02 and T03 rows for Vue, whose implementation owner stays CPF1. The compile capability table for the pinned release equals today's G02 in cell set and dispositions except the version-complement arms VueOtherVersion and SvelteOtherVersion, which are not cells. NCK5 (NCK5-AC1) deletes those arms after VIM1; VIM1 (VIM1-AC-R1) proves a complement fails as MN01, and the migrated outcome is DEM0 UnsupportedVersion
cases.forbidden: A compile capability inferred from the parser section; a cell keyed by the display framework string

cases.name: Current Svelte 5 carrier and semantic profile
cases.input: Carrier manifest with [parser] DK4 existing route PAR0 G04 and [compiler] client and server backends; semantic-profile manifest with release equal to the oracles.lock svelte pin, runes facets as typeinfo_role rows and both CE rows
cases.required: Both validate; rendered T01/T02/T03 rows match today's registered Svelte rows
cases.forbidden: A legacy-mode or other-version cell standing in for an activation outcome

cases.name: Synthetic neutral HTML carrier
cases.input: kind carrier, geometry neutral-carrier, [parser] DK3 fork into PAR0 home H08 with lineage, [compiler] none, [custom_elements] producer not-applicable with reason, consumer row, no semantic facets
cases.required: Validates; [compiler] none is a normal state; no semantic-profile section is required or accepted
cases.forbidden: A typeinfo_role row on a carrier manifest; an error for the missing backend

cases.name: Synthetic React overlay profile
cases.input: kind semantic-profile, geometry overlay (claim shape, not the TSX carrier's script-carrier geometry), claims the TSX script carrier, carrier [parser] untouched (no-parser for the profile), stage-one activation from a @jsxImportSource pragma and canonical role evidence, [compiler] absent, [[coexistence]] rows for Preact and Solid on the same carrier
cases.required: Validates; no parser or frontend is registered for the profile; overlap with peers is decided by declared relations
cases.forbidden: A React-specific parser; an extension-keyed activation; an overlap without a relation treated as success

cases.name: Synthetic Lit attachment profile
cases.input: kind semantic-profile, geometry attachment on tagged templates in the script carrier, [[embedding]] html`...` and css`...` regions with codecs and map-chain kinds, [custom_elements] producer and consumer rows
cases.required: Validates; embeddings name maps with ENC0 coordinate kinds at both ends; Lit is a CE producer
cases.forbidden: An embedding without a map; a missing CE producer row read as no custom elements

cases.name: Synthetic Angular template carrier and profile
cases.input: Carrier manifest: dedicated-carrier, [parser] DK3 over H08 or DK4 with the expression grammar recorded, [compiler] none. Profile manifest: exact release, FWA1 activation source, standalone-scope facets as typeinfo_role rows (inputs native, model change derived), NgModule scope as CT0 excluded with reason, [[public_surface]] routing TS regions to the tsgo host
cases.required: Validates; the NgModule exclusion is a truthful CT0 cell with a reason
cases.forbidden: An NgModule or *ngIf cell above CT0; a second activation source

cases.name: Synthetic project profile (Tailwind 4)
cases.input: kind project-profile, geometry project-overlay, one ProjectProfileId for the exact 4.x release, claims the CSS and markup semantic profiles it overlays, no [parser], no [compiler], [custom_elements] not-applicable with reason, budgets by performance-gates.toml row id
cases.required: Validates; the profile carries no carrier, parser or compiler
cases.forbidden: A [parser] or [compiler] section on a project profile; a manifest-declared threshold

cases.name: Versions array or a release on a carrier
cases.input: release = ["3.5", "3.6"], or a range, latest tag or 'anything other than 3.6' complement, or a release key on kind carrier
cases.required: Fails with the VM02 reason
cases.forbidden: Accepting the first element; minting one cell per element; giving one CarrierProfileId a manifest per release

cases.name: Untyped extension bag
cases.input: [extra], [metadata], an x-* key or an inline untyped map in any file
cases.required: Fails with the VM08 reason
cases.forbidden: Ignoring unknown keys

cases.name: Missing Custom Element row
cases.input: A semantic-profile manifest with [custom_elements] omitted, or with only a producer row
cases.required: Fails with the VM13 reason
cases.forbidden: Defaulting to not-applicable or no custom elements

cases.name: Compiler/parser conflation
cases.input: A [parser] entry carrying a compile capability or backend, a [compiler] entry naming a ParserId, or a compile cell justified only by a parser decision
cases.required: Fails with the VM09 reason
cases.forbidden: Deriving compile capability from tooling support

cases.name: Prose-only capability row
cases.input: A [[cell]] with only a note, or without producer, receiving acceptance or evidence id
cases.required: Fails with the VM20 reason
cases.forbidden: Rendering the note as a status

cases.name: Manifest-owned implementation logic
cases.input: A script, expression, regex, template or hook field in any manifest file
cases.required: Fails with the VM27 reason; nothing is executed
cases.forbidden: Evaluating the field

cases.name: Second hand-maintained truth
cases.input: A hand-edited rendered capability matrix, mirror or docs table that disagrees with the manifest, or a hand-maintained per-family matrix beside an existing manifest
cases.required: Fails freshness with the VM26 reason
cases.forbidden: Either copy winning

cases.name: Geometry proof shown as support
cases.input: A maturity at CT4 or CT3 whose only evidence is a static proof, installed parser, syntax highlighting or upstream install, or a CT3 maturity labelled static-proof
cases.required: Fails with the VM25 reason
cases.forbidden: Displaying the maturity as supported; claiming executed behaviour from static-proof

cases.name: Required cell silently removed
cases.input: A manifest omitting a required profile-qualified CapabilityId, or omitting a published surface from that cell's per-surface maturity value, or excluding a surface without an admitted reason
cases.required: Fails with the VM21 reason
cases.forbidden: Treating the omission as not applicable; widening the T07 key with host or carrier

cases.name: Full support authored over an unimplemented cell
cases.input: A manifest field declaring full support while a required cell is CT1-CT3
cases.required: Fails with the VM21 reason; full support is derived only
cases.forbidden: Accepting an authored support level

cases.name: Merged Tailwind identity
cases.input: One project-profile manifest claiming Tailwind 3 and 4, or a migration manifest minting a combined ProjectProfileId
cases.required: Fails with the VM28 reason; both profiles active in one scope is DEM0's typed ambiguity
cases.forbidden: One live workspace identity for both majors

cases.name: Dynamic plugin
cases.input: A manifest naming a loadable module, native library or runtime plugin to supply rows
cases.required: Fails with the VM27 reason; an external contribution enters only as a typed T09 row
cases.forbidden: Loading the plugin

cases.name: Second activation source or semantic stage-one evidence
cases.input: [activation] naming a lint switch or file-name probe as a source, or a stage-one fact kind that needs TypeScript or TypeInfo
cases.required: Fails with the VM10 reason
cases.forbidden: Activating from spelling

cases.name: Self-selected performance gate
cases.input: A [[budget]] with an inline threshold, an unknown gate id, or a required cell with no budget reference where its gate row requires one
cases.required: Fails with the VM16 reason
cases.forbidden: Gating on the manifest's own number

cases.name: Release and oracle pin diverge
cases.input: release 3.6.0-rc.3 with an oracles.lock vue pin 3.6.0-rc.5 (the VIM-F01 shape)
cases.required: Fails with the VM23 reason
cases.forbidden: Either value winning silently

cases.name: Unknown or retired owner
cases.input: A cell, deletion or owner field naming a retired block (B2, BV1), a person, or a node or acceptance ID that does not exist
cases.required: Fails with the VM06 reason
cases.forbidden: Accepting free-text ownership

cases.name: Geometry on the wrong kind
cases.input: A semantic-profile or project-profile manifest whose geometry is a carrier class (dedicated-carrier, script-carrier, neutral-carrier, embedded-syntax, document-language, dsl) or equals a claimed carrier's geometry, or a carrier manifest whose geometry is overlay, attachment or project-overlay
cases.required: Fails with the VM05 reason
cases.forbidden: Keeping two geometry authorities with no binding; letting either win
